primary.role: Primary banner schedule source for all three games. It publishes current/next banners and server-region countdowns.
primary.update_policy: Sync frequently; Prydwen states it waits for official confirmation and aims to update within 24 hours.

fallback.role: Optional API fallback/validation. It requires an API key and its free tier can lag by about 24 hours, so it is not used as the primary live source.

app_contract.countdown: Calculated locally from end_at; the app does not store a ticking countdown.
